expected.mutant:
throws: cannot resolve a node with !<tag:yaml.org,2002:int> explicit tag (1:4)

 1 | a: !!int 0o17
--------^

note: In the explicit-integer pattern the octal alternative's sign becomes mandatory, so an explicitly tagged unsigned octal integer no longer resolves. Bare `0o17` still parses through the implicit pattern, which is what hides it.
